sentences.text: This animal likely lived as a generalized predator on the floodplains of its environment.
It was the most abundant crocodilian found in the Nacimiento Formation.
The genus was named in 1942 by the paleontologist Charles C. Mook.
Remains have been discovered in the Nacimiento Formation within the San Juan Basin of New Mexico.
Scientists disagree on the precise classification of Navajosuchus within the group Alligatoroidea.
Some research suggests it is a basal member of the family Alligatoridae, specifically within the subgroup Alligatorinae.
Other studies propose that it belongs outside Alligatoridae and Alligatorinae, instead placing it as a basal member of the clade Globidonta.
The animal lived from the Danian to the Selandian stages, approximately 66 to 60.9 million years ago.
